mapper.select: select a.ID as id, a.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, a.PROJECT_NAME as projectName, a.COUNTERPARTY as counterparty, a.SECONDPARTY as secondparty, a.COMPANY_OR_DEPARTMENT as companyOrDepartment, a.`OWNER` as owner, a.SUM_AMOUNT as sumAmount, a.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, b.TYPE as bizProjectType, b.MANAGE_DEPT as manageDept from BIZ_CRM_HETONG a left join BIZ_PROJECT b on a.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
